masalah_tujuan.value: The paper addresses the lack of treatment cost transparency and initial diagnosis accuracy in the Indonesian beauty clinic sector by developing an AI-driven system using RAG and LLMs to provide accurate predictions and transparent cost estimations.

subdomain_kesehatan.value: The system targets beauty clinic patients to provide preliminary diagnosis prediction and transparent cost estimation for services.

retriever_embedding.value: The retriever is orchestrated by the LangChain framework using parallel retrieval. The embedding model is all-MiniLM-L6-v2 Sentence Transformer, and the vector database is FAISS.

dataset_knowledge_base.value: The system uses a MySQL relational database (nand_ssc) for structured service data, a FAISS vector store for semantic knowledge, and an evaluation dataset consisting of 20 unseen simulated patient queries.

metrik_evaluasi.value: Semantic Similarity of Notes (BERTScore F1), Service Extraction Precision, Service Extraction Recall, Service Extraction F1 Score, and Cost Extraction Accuracy.

evaluasi_faithfulness.value: Hallucination is managed through RAG, prompt engineering, and knowledge base updates. The study emphasizes continuous monitoring of hallucinations and identifies human-in-the-loop validation as a future requirement for high-stakes recommendations.

bahasa_data.value: The system processes user input in Indonesian, as evidenced by query examples and output explanations provided in the context.

hasil_utama.value: The system achieved an average semantic similarity of 0.73, service extraction precision of 0.73, recall of 0.72, F1 score of 0.72, and cost extraction accuracy of 0.72 across 20 simulated evaluation datasets.

keterbatasan.value: Limitations include reliance on MySQL knowledge table quality, potential search misses due to query phrasing, a small evaluation dataset of 20 queries, and the focus on complaint-based prediction rather than professional medical diagnosis.

future_work.value: Future work includes validating diagnostics with certified dermatologists, using diverse multi-clinic datasets, exploring advanced pricing models, implementing staff feedback loops, conducting user satisfaction studies, testing extensibility to other medical domains, and monitoring LLM hallucinations.

masalah_tujuan.value: To develop a learning-to-rank system that enhances RAG-based EMR search engines by quickly learning users' specific search semantics from a limited number of positive labels.

subdomain_kesehatan.value: Clinical chart review using electronic medical records (EMR) search engines.

retriever_embedding.value: The paper uses word embeddings trained with EMRs for semantic similarity calculations to rank documents.

strategi_chunking.value: The system identifies relevant sentences within documents based on keyword similarity to the search query, rather than using standard fixed-size chunking.

dataset_knowledge_base.value: Clinical notes extracted from VUMC's EMR system (specifically for diabetes and seizure cohorts) and a pilot study on cancer-progression notes.

hasil_utama.value: The approach outperformed baselines, achieving at least 0.60 P@10 with only ten positive labels, and improved LLM F1 scores for cancer-progression tasks from 0.14 to 0.50.

keterbatasan.value: The study assumes only words near keywords impact user decisions and does not account for non-language features or word relationships distant from the search terms.

future_work.value: Testing more state-of-the-art LLMs and further evaluating the framework's performance.

masalah_tujuan.value: To develop and evaluate a multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) framework for generating clinically accurate chest X-ray reports by investigating similarity metrics and negative sampling impact.

subdomain_kesehatan.value: Medical AI, specifically radiology report generation for chest X-rays.

retriever_embedding.value: TorchXRayVision is used for visual feature extraction, and four similarity metrics (Cosine, Euclidean, Jaccard, and Hamming) are evaluated for retrieval.

strategi_chunking.value: Not reported. The framework uses training reports as exemplars based on vector similarity rather than specific text-chunking methods.

metrik_evaluasi.value: Clinical metrics (CheXbert and RadGraph) and linguistic metrics (BERTScore, BLEU, METEOR, ROUGE-L).

evaluasi_faithfulness.value: The paper uses automatic clinical and linguistic metrics to measure generation quality. It evaluates factual grounding by comparing RAG performance against non-retrieval baselines.

hasil_utama.value: RAG outperformed non-retrieval baselines. Non-binary probability vectors with Euclidean or Cosine similarity in Full Retrieval performed best; prompt-level negative sampling degraded performance.

keterbatasan.value: Prompt-level negative sampling consistently degraded performance. Partial retrieval could miss less probable conditions, and binary encodings lost subtle probability information.

masalah_tujuan.value: To evaluate the performance of six different retrieval strategies within a RAG pipeline for clinical named entity recognition in aged care settings.

subdomain_kesehatan.value: Clinical information extraction (named entity recognition) in aged care, specifically extracting symptoms of agitation in dementia and malnutrition risk factors from nursing notes.

retriever_embedding.value: Sentence-BERT (all-mpnet-base-v2) embedding model used in a FAISS vector database. Retrieval strategies include sparse (BM25), dense, cross-encoder reranking, and hybrid fusion.

strategi_chunking.value: Documents are segmented into fixed-length segments of 250 tokens when segmentation is required for retrieval.

dataset_knowledge_base.value: Nursing progress notes from 40 residential aged care facilities in New South Wales, Australia, between 2019 and 2021 (208 records per task).

metrik_evaluasi.value: Context F1, Answer F1, Faithfulness F1, Contextual Diversity, and Item-level Accuracy.

evaluasi_faithfulness.value: Faithfulness F1 is computed using BERTScore to compare the semantic similarity between the generated answer and the retrieved evidence, penalizing unsupported or contradicting claims.

hasil_utama.value: Dense reranking strategies consistently outperformed single-stage retrieval methods across all evaluation metrics, demonstrating improved contextual grounding and factual faithfulness for clinical extraction tasks.

keterbatasan.value: Evaluated only two clinical IE tasks; did not evaluate relation extraction, temporal reasoning, or free-form clinical questions; findings are specific to schema-driven NER.

future_work.value: Expand evaluation to a broader range of clinical IE tasks, including those with different entity densities, longer reasoning chains, free-form queries, and potential implementation of constrained decoding for output consistency.

masalah_tujuan.value: To address suboptimal machine translation quality for Indian languages in domain-specific contexts by developing a RAG framework that improves contextual grounding and reduces hallucinations.

subdomain_kesehatan.value: The paper targets healthcare, legal, sports, education, and news domains, specifically focusing on translating domain-specific medical texts.

retriever_embedding.value: FAISS (Facebook AI Similarity Search) is used as the vector database, with MiniLM, DistilUSE, and LaBSE as sentence embedding models.

strategi_chunking.value: Retrieval uses sentence-level chunks from domain-specific parallel corpora.

dataset_knowledge_base.value: The Anuvaad parallel corpus, which provides English-Hindi parallel sentences across healthcare, legal, sports, education, and news domains.

metrik_evaluasi.value: BLEU, CHRF++, METEOR, COMET, and BERT Similarity.

evaluasi_faithfulness.value: Evaluated via qualitative comparison of RAG outputs versus zero-shot models and through BERT Similarity scores to assess semantic preservation and hallucination reduction.

hasil_utama.value: The RAG-based approach consistently outperformed zero-shot methods across all domains, particularly in semantic accuracy, while effectively reducing hallucinations.

keterbatasan.value: Challenges include complex syntactic variations in Indic languages, OOV terms, inconsistent terminology handling, and the limited subset of Indic languages supported by the BLOOMZ model.

future_work.value: Expanding to more languages, adopting larger multilingual models, integrating hallucination detection, improving tokenization strategies, and further optimizing low-resource adaptation techniques.

masalah_tujuan.value: To address challenges in the Indonesian healthcare system like resource limitations and medical expertise distribution by using RAG to provide accurate, context-aware AI clinical decision support.

subdomain_kesehatan.value: Clinical decision support systems for doctors in primary healthcare facilities.

retriever_embedding.value: Uses OpenAI text-embedding-3-small for embeddings and DataStax Astra DB as the vector database.

generator_llm.value: GPT-4o mini by OpenAI and Claude 3.5 Haiku by Anthropic.

strategi_chunking.value: PDF files are cleaned to remove special characters/whitespaces and split into chunks of 1000-1200 characters.

dataset_knowledge_base.value: Indonesian Clinical Practice Guidelines (PDF) and a consultation dataset of over 100 patient cases (DOCX).

metrik_evaluasi.value: METEOR score, Cosine Similarity, Precision, Recall, and F1-Score.

evaluasi_faithfulness.value: Evaluated by comparing model output's semantic alignment and lexical matches against official clinical guidelines and reference diagnoses using METEOR and Cosine Similarity.

hasil_utama.value: RAG-based models (GPT-4o mini and Claude 3.5 Haiku) outperformed non-RAG models, achieving higher METEOR scores, semantic similarity, and perfect recall, ensuring better compliance with medical guidelines.

keterbatasan.value: Limited development budget, latency due to server location (US), limited resources on the Vercel hobby plan, and dependency on third-party models.

future_work.value: Explore lightweight, locally runnable AI to reduce costs and dependency, and prioritize data privacy through encryption and secure RAG data storage.

masalah_tujuan.value: To automate the mapping of audit-identified vulnerabilities to healthcare compliance frameworks (HIPAA and ISO 27001), addressing the manual, error-prone, and resource-intensive nature of current compliance processes.

subdomain_kesehatan.value: Healthcare compliance auditing, specifically mapping security vulnerabilities to regulatory standards like HIPAA and ISO 27001.

retriever_embedding.value: Embeddings use OpenAI (text-embedding-ada-002) or Hugging Face (Sentence-BERT all-MiniLM-L6-v2). Vector database uses FAISS (Facebook AI Similarity Search) with Flat or IVFFlat index.

generator_llm.value: The framework supports various LLMs via APIs, with GPT-4 or Llama 2 specifically mentioned as candidates for the generation phase.

strategi_chunking.value: Regulatory documents undergo PDF parsing and are split into semantically coherent segments, ensuring each unit reflects a complete, interpretable control.

dataset_knowledge_base.value: A unified knowledge base containing HIPAA and ISO 27001 regulatory standards.

metrik_evaluasi.value: Semantic mapping accuracy (measured via simulated cosine similarity) and reduction in manual effort (time saved).

evaluasi_faithfulness.value: Hallucinations are addressed via factual scoring, iterative RAG, citation alignment, and prompt engineering to emphasize context and control objectives.

bahasa_data.value: The paper implies the system handles English, as the regulatory frameworks (HIPAA, ISO 27001) and examples provided are in English.

hasil_utama.value: Simulations indicate a potential 85% accuracy in semantic mapping and a 70-80% reduction in manual effort compared to traditional audit processes.

keterbatasan.value: The study is conceptual, lacks empirical evaluation on real-world datasets, and faces challenges including data privacy, potential model hallucinations, semantic misalignment, and system infrastructure load.

future_work.value: Future work includes cross-jurisdictional standard integration (GDPR, HITRUST), real-time regulatory monitoring, RLHF-based fine-tuning, real-time auditing integration, and ethical AI/liability modeling.

masalah_tujuan.value: To address limitations of medical LLMs like hallucinations and knowledge obsolescence by providing a comprehensive survey of medical Multimodal RAG, analyzing its technical foundations, challenges, and applications.

subdomain_kesehatan.value: Multimodal medical diagnosis, radiology and pathology report generation, surgical planning, clinical documentation, medical education, and mental health services.

retriever_embedding.value: Techniques include sparse retrieval (TF-IDF, BM25), dense retrieval (BERT), hybrid search, hierarchical retrieval (RAPTOR), and iterative retrieval (FLARE). Generative retrieval methods (GENIUS) and multi-task retrievers are also mentioned.

generator_llm.value: The generator is typically an LLM or MLLM, such as Med-PaLM 2, Me-LLaMA, LLaVA-Med, or Med-PaLM M, which integrates retrieved document chunks to produce responses.

strategi_chunking.value: Not reported. The paper discusses retrieval strategies like hierarchical structures (RAPTOR) and dynamic context selection, but does not specify document chunking sizes or overlap settings.

dataset_knowledge_base.value: Datasets include MIMIC-III, MIMIC-IV, MIMIC-CXR, IU X-Ray, CheXpert, TCGA, PMC-OA, Quilt-1M, Harvard-FairVLMed, and MultiMedQA/MultiMedBench.

metrik_evaluasi.value: Metrics include BLEU, ROUGE, METEOR, BERTScore, F1-CheXbert, F1-RadGraph, Accuracy, Precision, Recall, and the 'LLM-as-a-Judge' paradigm.

evaluasi_faithfulness.value: Evaluated through factual consistency metrics like F1-CheXbert and F1-RadGraph, entity probing, and decoupled evaluation frameworks like RAG-Check and RULE to measure alignment with retrieved contexts.

bahasa_data.value: Primarily English-centric, as identified by the authors as a major linguistic bias in existing datasets and models.

hasil_utama.value: Frameworks like RULE, MMed-RAG, and FactMM-RAG show consistent performance improvements in medical VQA and report generation, demonstrating better factual accuracy compared to baselines across various metrics.

keterbatasan.value: Challenges include hallucinations, knowledge obsolescence, data privacy, bias, scarcity of high-quality/balanced multimodal data, and high procedural complexity in frameworks like EMERGE.

future_work.value: Future efforts should focus on cross-modal understanding, complex reasoning, data-efficient learning, mitigating model bias to enhance fairness, and building high-quality, diverse medical datasets covering various clinical tasks.

masalah_tujuan.value: To improve medical knowledge understanding and medical semantic reasoning using an enhanced retrieval-augmented generative modeling algorithm.

subdomain_kesehatan.value: Medical knowledge understanding, medical semantic reasoning, and clinical decision support.

retriever_embedding.value: A combination of a transformer-based dense retriever and a TF-IDF sparse retriever with an adaptive weight fusion method.

generator_llm.value: Qwen-14B-Chat was used as the base model.

dataset_knowledge_base.value: Medical Knowledge Understanding and Reasoning Ability Evaluation Competition dataset, containing 9,788 questions, 5,473 practice questions, and 29,497 NLI data pairs.

metrik_evaluasi.value: Accuracy (Acc), Rouge-1, Rouge-L, BertScore, and SARI.

hasil_utama.value: The proposed method improved average comprehensive evaluation metrics by +3.86% compared to four base models, achieving superior performance in knowledge understanding and semantic reasoning.

keterbatasan.value: Data originates from a competition and may lack real-world clinical diversity; evaluation relies on standard metrics rather than in-depth performance in actual clinical environments.

future_work.value: Expanding data sources with real clinical cases, developing explainable models, and integrating the method into clinical decision support systems and intelligent consultation platforms.

masalah_tujuan.value: To develop a lightweight, resource-efficient Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system using Small Language Models (SLMs) for domain-specific tasks (insurance) on standard CPU hardware, while ensuring factual accuracy and reducing hallucinations.

subdomain_kesehatan.value: Not reported. The paper targets the insurance domain and mentions healthcare as a potential future application.

retriever_embedding.value: Embedding model: paraphrase-multilingual-MiniLM-L12-v2; Reranker model: cross-encoder/ms-marco-MiniLM-L-6-v2.

strategi_chunking.value: Documents are converted to plain text using PyMuPDF and divided into overlapping chunks.

dataset_knowledge_base.value: Five insurance documents in PDF format (policy descriptions, claim procedures, customer service transcripts) and regional news articles.

metrik_evaluasi.value: Factual accuracy, hallucination rate, average latency (on CPU), and peak memory usage.

evaluasi_faithfulness.value: Evaluated by comparing chatbot responses against insurance document content to measure factual accuracy and hallucination rates. RAG-SLM achieved 85.1% accuracy and 11.5% hallucination rate.

hasil_utama.value: The RAG-SLM system achieved a 30% reduction in hallucination, 85.1% factual accuracy, and 8–12 seconds latency on CPU-only hardware (Intel Xeon Silver 4116), demonstrating efficiency comparable to larger models.

keterbatasan.value: Higher latency (8–12 seconds) compared to GPU-accelerated deployments, which achieve response times below 2 seconds.

future_work.value: Lowering latency through model compression, enabling real-time knowledge base updates, incorporating multimodal inputs, and extending the framework to healthcare and law domains.
